data.name: YOTEL Porto
data.hotelDescription:
Modern Accommodation in Porto

Convenient Facilities: YOTEL Porto offers a fitness centre, private parking, a garden, and a terrace for guests to enjoy during their stay. With a restaurant, room service, and a 24-hour front desk, your needs are always catered to effortlessly.

Comfortable Rooms: The air-conditioned rooms are equipped with essential amenities such as a desk, kettle, fridge, safety deposit box, flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom with a shower. The property also ensures a cozy stay with bed linen and towels provided in all rooms.

Prime Location: Situated just 1.1 km from Sao Bento Metro Station, the hotel is conveniently close to popular landmarks like Sao Bento Train Station, Oporto Coliseum, and Clerigos Tower, offering easy access to explore the city.

Book your stay at YOTEL Porto for a memorable experience in Porto!

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Generally praised as very clean and 'hotel novinho / super limpo' in several reviews, with one mention of 'limpieza regular' — overall slightly above average.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff repeatedly described as friendly and helpful (reception and restaurant praised); some comments about understaffing at very busy times but overall strong service sentiment.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Consistently highlighted as excellent/strategic and very close to metro/attractions ('Localização excelente', 'proche du métro', 'muy cerca de la estación de metro').

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Mixed feedback: comfortable beds and modern rooms noted, but multiple complaints about small room size, awkward bathroom configuration/privacy (glass walls), poor lighting and few sockets — lowers the score.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Gym and underground parking are positives and minibar/restaurant noted; some negatives about minibar not cooling, limited sockets and low-quality shower toiletries.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Several guests called it good value ('Bom custo beneficio', 'Preco honesto'), though some noted breakfast price is high for the city — overall slightly above target.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast is repeatedly praised as very good and varied across many reviews, though one mention of occasional fruit shortage and one comment on price.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Overall positive guest experience: many strong recommendations and return intent, tempered by specific issues for some (lighting, room layout, accessibility for elderly).
